tasks.final_text:
Good Evening,

This morning I was in a team meeting and asked to share my favorite meal. Naturally, I chose the meal in Santorini, high on the cliffs, and thought of you. What a memory that was, the warm ocean air, the bruschetta! I just want to say, thank you for such a wonderful experience together. I look forward to the next opportunity to travel together.

Yours truly

The men's singles was a tennis event held as part of the tennis program at the 1904 Summer Olympics. It was the third time the event was held at the Olympics. There were 27 competitors from 2 nations. The event was won by Beals Wright, with the Americans sweeping the medals.
